description.en: A slender trunk supports a crown of many leafless twig-like branches.
description.zh: 细长树干支撑由许多无叶细枝构成的树冠。

scientific_scope.en: Conservative whole-organism reconstruction concept for Calamophyton; cited fossils support gross structures, while unpreserved proportions and colour remain artistic choices.
scientific_scope.zh: Calamophyton 的保守整株重建概念；所引化石支持主要结构，未保存比例和颜色仍属美术选择。

distinctness.en: Twiggy crown and shed-branch trunk distinguish it from palm fronds, cycads and the existing Lepidodendron crown.
distinctness.zh: 细枝冠及落枝树干区别于棕榈羽叶、苏铁及现有鳞木冠。

modeling_brief.en: Create tapered branch bundles without leaf cards; make the crown outline uneven while retaining its documented architecture.
modeling_brief.zh: 以渐细枝束建冠，不使用叶片卡；在保留已知架构的前提下作不规则轮廓。

uncertainty: Exact crown density and internal trunk construction are not inferred from the exterior model.
reference_notes: Planning record only. Source access labels distinguish opened pages from indexed abstracts/excerpts. Reference-ready is not a released model or a completed dimensional/rights audit.

sources.title: Earth's earliest forest revealed in Somerset fossils
sources.supports: Calamophyton trunks, twiggy crown and branch shedding in a Devonian forest.
